name: Integration hub
description: Signed inbound webhooks through which external systems report incidents, and outbound subscriptions that forward selected platform events (signed, with retries and a delivery log) to destinations on the operator's allow-list.

roles.name: Tenant administrator
roles.description: Creates endpoints and subscriptions and rotates their secrets

roles.name: Auditor
roles.description: Reads endpoint messages and delivery logs

lifecycle.on_deactivate: The integrations capability is withdrawn: inbound endpoints answer 'not found', pending deliveries fail without being sent, and endpoint, subscription and delivery records are kept.
